3 The above results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standard prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, as amended and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and guidelines issued by the Securities and Exchange Board of India ('SEBI').

4 During the previous year ended March 31, 2026, the Holding Company has completed its Initial Public Offer ("IPO") of 2,56,85,062 equity shares of face value of INR 5 each at an issue price of share INR 227 per share (INR 216 per share for equity shares issued to employees) comprising fresh issue of 1,84,16,340 equity shares (including 46,296 equity shares issued to employees) and offer for sale of 72,68,722 equity shares by selling shareholders. Pursuant to the IPO, the equity shares of the Holding Company are listed on National Stock Exchange of India Limited ('NSE') and BSE Limited ('BSE') on March 5, 2026.

5 Consequent to IPO of the Holding Company as explained in note 4 above, the statement of unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is drawn for the first time in accordance with the requirement of Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulations. The said unaudited quarterly and half yearly consolidated financial results have not been subject to an audit or review by our statutory auditors and are approved by the Company's Board of Directors. However, the management of the holding company has exercised necessary due diligence to ensure that the said results for this period provide a true and fair view of the Group's affairs.

The revision in cost of objects and reallocation of surplus issue expense proceeds of INR 15.03 million was approved by the Board of Directors vide resolution dated July 18, 2026.

7 The Group is predominantly operating in one segment i.e. manufacturing of high precision engineered components & assemblies. Accordingly, there are no separate reportable segments in accordance with the requirements of Ind AS 108 ‘Operating segment’.

8 During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Group changed its method of depreciation from the written down value method to the straight-line method, based on holding company's management’s reassessment of the expected economic benefits from those assets. The said change is treated as a change in accounting estimate in accordance with Ind AS 8 and hence accounted for prospectively from the current financial year. Had the Group continued to apply the written down value method, depreciation expense would have been higher by INR 15.07 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and by INR 29.29 million for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Consequently, profit before tax would have been lower by INR 15.07 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, resulting in profit before tax of INR 388.23 million, and lower by INR 29.29 million for the half year ended September 30, 2026, resulting in profit before tax of INR 770.84 million.

9 The Holding Company has formulated an employee stock option scheme namely the Omnitech Engineering Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2025 ("ESOP scheme") pursuant to resolutions passed by the Board on May 3, 2025 and the Shareholders on May 16, 2025. As on the date of these results, there are no options vested or granted under the said ESOP scheme.

10 The figures for the previous reporting period(s) have been regrouped / reclassified wherever necessary to correspond with the current period's classification.
